findings.text: follow-on: the fragment says the hardcoded normal-probe positions are 'numerically identical to the tangential ones in mgset0.f', and the run's evidence_inputs repeats it. Read on the host, mgset0.f:13-18 RPSTM(I,1) R components are 4.4911, 4.2980, 3.8788, 3.3983, 3.0050, ... while RPSNM(I,1) R components are 4.4831, 4.3080, 3.8888, 3.4033, 3.0050, ... so the R defaults differ (~1e-2); only the Z defaults (ZPSTM=ZPSNM) are identical. The negative finding that no independent normal-probe geometry exists still holds, but the equality is overstated. The committed receipt JSON does not carry the claim; it appears only in the fragment and the manifest prose.
